classification_semantics.production_safe_purpose_bound: Callable through the current default gate. A DP label is conditional on the route-specific signed policy, immutable snapshot and stated threat model. Registered Count, Frequency and Synopsis releases derive sticky noise from persistent peer identity seeds and have no lifetime ledger; retained capsule source/ticket endpoints are not statistical releases.
classification_semantics.test_or_guarded_migration_internals: Retired from registration and export. These closures remain namespace-internal only for transport diagnostics or migration regression tests and have no production public route.
classification_semantics.quarantined_compatibility_internals: Retired from registration and export. Historical client implementations remain only behind a non-configurable local frontdoor guard for source-level migration tests; they carry no DP or non-reconstruction claim.
classification_semantics.orphan_remove_candidate: Registered but has no resolved client expression. Removal would still require a compatibility decision.
classification_semantics.dangerous_remove_candidate: Registered, disclosure-prone and has no resolved client expression. None currently meet all three conditions.
classification_semantics.internal_unregistered: Defined in the server namespace for source compatibility or tests, including explicitly retired remote methods, but neither registered nor exported and therefore not remotely invocable.

retired_surface_consumer_audit.coverage_contract: The union of retired_registered_surface arrays is exactly the 105 formerly registered endpoints. Every executable client construction of one of these endpoints is either test-only or dominated by a local dsvert_route_unavailable:v1 guard before connection discovery and DSI expression submission; dsvertImputeColumnDS has no executable client construction. The three unregistered client constructions listed in client_ast_resolution.locally_quarantined_unregistered_endpoints are likewise locally blocked before DSI.

test_only_or_internal_consumers.exactGCGLMSoftplusPrepareDS: producer-bound legacy GLM softplus helper, locally guarded
test_only_or_internal_consumers.exactGCVecmulBindInputsDS: manifest-free legacy exact multiplication branch, locally guarded

retired_surface_consumer_audit.shared_legacy_consumers: The generic session, Ring63/Ring127, Beaver/OT, score and cluster kernels remain implementation dependencies of retained legacy GLM, Cox, NB, multinomial, ordinal, LMM, GEE, GLMM, IPW and MI helpers. The signed LMM/GLMM Synopsis readers do not invoke those helpers.

client_ast_resolution.direct_literal_call: 181 distinct endpoints constructed with call(name = <one string>)

bounded_dynamic_call.runtime_guard: any other value is rejected before a DSI expression is built

client_ast_resolution.unregistered_client_endpoints: 104 currently constructed retired_registered_surface endpoints plus locally_quarantined_unregistered_endpoints (107 distinct endpoint constructions)

diagnostic_only_endpoints.mpcTypedSourceProbeDS: unregistered data-free typed source-stream validation in server/client transport tests; it is not a statistical producer

retired_after_ast_audit.dsvertContingencyDS: No executable client call, as.call/as.name construction or bounded dynamic allowlist entry remained; inventory and test string literals are not consumers. The exact-table endpoint is now unregistered and unexported.
retired_after_ast_audit.legacy_chisq_guard_and_product: The fixed-shape categorical capsule replaced all seven legacy chi-square guard, product and joint-release calls; no executable client construction remained.
retired_after_ast_audit.legacy_one_hot_and_vector_share: The categorical capsule and typed vector transport replaced dsvertOneHotDS plus the two generic Beaver vector-share endpoints; no executable client construction remained.
retired_after_ast_audit.legacy_psi_and_exact_local_correlation: The fixed-capacity pinned PSI route replaced every variable-shape PSI expression. localCorDS and all legacy PSI closures were hard-deleted after their client consumers reached zero; psiPaddedExactTransportDS was folded into psiPaddedANDStartDS so the promoted route has exactly sixteen purpose-bound entry points.

adaptive_exact_or_reconstructible_summar.risk: Threshold suppression does not provide composition or non-reconstruction protection against repeated or differenced exact releases.
adaptive_exact_or_reconstructible_summar.required_action: Migrate each high-level consumer to one accountant-bound DP release or a purpose-bound joint MPC/DP opening, then unregister the exact endpoint.

padded_psi_threat_boundary.risk: The public capacity bucket bounds local input shape and the relay observes K plus availability/timing. Both designated exact-GC compute peers colluding is outside the membership-confidentiality claim; the relay can always deny service.
padded_psi_threat_boundary.required_action: Keep every phase fixed by K and the public bucket, retain name pinning, signed contracts/envelopes/receipts and durable replay protection, and release cohort size only through a separately authorized DP artifact when scientifically required.

cluster_granular_or_identifier_metadata.risk: Exact per-cluster sizes, levels, order metadata or reconstructible shares create a granular differencing surface; a minimum cluster size is not a composition theorem.
cluster_granular_or_identifier_metadata.required_action: Keep cluster membership inside authenticated peers and open only model-level, contribution-bounded DP outputs; retain these endpoints only for quarantined cluster-granular GEE and legacy LMM/GLMM helpers, never for the signed Synopsis readers.

aggregate_method_mutates_server_data.risk: These aggregate registrations create or modify server-side analysis columns and also return data-dependent status or counts. They bypass the narrower semantic expectations of an AssignMethod.
aggregate_method_mutates_server_data.required_action: Replace with purpose-bound immutable derived-object creation, fixed names/tickets and no exact data-dependent acknowledgement before removing the old aggregate registration.

generic_untyped_blob_or_session_reducer.risk: Caller-selected session slots or generic reductions make protocol confusion and unintended exact openings easier to compose.
generic_untyped_blob_or_session_reducer.required_action: Finish typed ticket migration and replace every generic reducer with a producer-, shape-, destination- and one-opening-bound endpoint; unregister only after the AST consumer set reaches zero.

typed_transport_pilot.risk: A ticket-bound typed read and the data-free source probe are transport primitives, not authorized statistical openings. Their payloads must remain producer-minted and purpose-bound.
typed_transport_pilot.required_action: Keep the source probe internal; admit a typed read only with its fixed capability and independently audited opening contract.

operational_status_only.risk: No protected statistic is intended, but DP status can reveal operational policy/accountant progress and all values must remain custodian-owned or public.
operational_status_only.required_action: Keep schemas fixed and data-independent; never add snapshot-derived counts, hashes or failure detail to these replies.

disclosure_safe_gate.important_limit: There is one installed disclosure-safe profile. Retired compatibility and migration endpoints are unregistered and unexported, cannot be enabled by a runtime option, and retain an internal server gate plus a local client frontdoor guard as defence in depth.

joint_mpc_single_opening.dsi_control_plane: purpose-bound signed two-authority execution with durable sticky replay, authenticated final chunks and no request, rate or catalogue admission gate
joint_mpc_single_opening.current_guarantee: The relay receives no private source share, sticky seed, sampled noise, pre-clamp value or noised share; the public release is the signed, replayable final DP vector only.

immediate_removal_decision.hard_delete_reason: The retired per-query DP wrappers had no registered or exported route and depended only on the removed bare SQLite release engine. The superseded scalar Count capsule/ledger phases and generic scalar control-plane frontdoor likewise had no registered, exported or production-client route; their remaining callers were dedicated regression tests and retired adapters. Product-bound vector allocation retains only its shared receipt codec and allocation phases. The client also has one fixed-capacity padded PSI route, so the variable-shape protocol and its exact cardinality/local-correlation openings have no compatibility consumer. Keeping these closures would only preserve accidental direct-call surface. The redundant padded transport phase is now an idempotent internal step of psiPaddedANDStartDS.
immediate_removal_decision.reason: The public methods migrated to the manifest-bound joint vector and categorical capsules. The six obsolete per-query DP wrappers, their bare SQLite release engine, the superseded scalar Count capsule/ledger lifecycle and the generic scalar control-plane frontdoor are hard-deleted. The exact adaptive descriptive histogram, unused exact contingency release, mutable correlation controls, legacy chi-square guard/product lifecycle, exact one-hot helper and generic Beaver vector-share calls remain only as unregistered, unexported test/source-compatibility functions.
immediate_removal_decision.next_removal_gate: A registered endpoint may become a candidate only after its replacement is live, all client AST consumers are gone, it is absent from retry/transport inventories and focused plus full compatibility suites pass.

claim_boundary.default_surface: Eligible only for the endpoint-specific conditional claims above.
claim_boundary.legacy_surface: MPC can hide intermediates from the relay, but exact and adaptive outputs remain composable and potentially reconstructive.
claim_boundary.all_peer_collusion_or_host_compromise: out of scope unless separately mitigated and attested
